next_action.description: FIRST JOB: fix the _stage2 resolution for a model with no _stage2 twin. Finish/Continue 404s on comfy_workflows/minimax_h3_fl2va_stage2.json, which does not and must not exist - H3 is the first model to ship ONE workflow file for both stages (MPI-449 made it possible by giving MpiSaveLatent a lazy `enabled` input, and it is the precedent MPI-456 wants for LTX's six and WAN's two twins). The unconditional suffix is applied by resolveWorkflowFile() in js/data/modelConstants/resolveModelDeps.js, called from js/services/commandExecutor.js:1391 with { stage2: payload.isStage2 === true }. The correct behaviour is to fall back to the BASE file when no _stage2 twin exists - H3's stage 2 is the same graph driven by Input_Is_Continue / Input_Preview_Only through the lazy MpiIfElse gates, which is why Input_Is_Continue exists in the graph at all. SWEEP THE BLAST RADIUS before editing: resolveWorkflowFile is a shared resolver used by every model, and this session already found TWO half-wires from exactly this pattern - grep every caller, and check whether PROGRESS_STAGES / _stageMode (commandExecutor.js:1502) and comfyController.js:1219 make the same twin assumption. Then re-test step 6 end to end, DELETING THE EXISTING COLD PREVIEWS FIRST because status:'missing' is baked into each sidecar at save time. After that: step 5 (i2v), step 8 (preview clip), the t2v preview-steps decision, then ref2va.

key_decisions: The licence is BUNDLED, not linked, and that was decided by reading Section III.1 rather than by preference: it obliges a copy to anyone who receives the Works OR USES YOUR PRODUCTS OR SERVICES RELATED THERETO. A link to huggingface.co names a copy rather than providing one, and dies offline or when the publisher moves the file.

The 'Powered by MiniMax H3' attribution sits on the MODEL (Model Library drawer), not app-wide. User's call and the better reading of Section III.3.a, which scopes the notice to a product 'developed using MiniMax H3' - that is the model entry, not Vision.
MPI-459 (curated pip vs a running engine) was CARDED, not patched at the crash site, per the ROOT-CAUSE RULE. It is a shared install-path problem, deliberately out of MPI-452's scope.

The i2v aspect concern from MPI-449 research line 377 is CLOSED as a non-issue and must not be re-opened: nodes 218/220 (ImageResizeKJv2, keep_proportion crop, crop_position center, divisible_by 32) cover-crop BOTH frames to canvas size before the H3 node, so its plain stretch is a no-op, and all 15 MINIMAX_H3_RATIOS entries are divisible by 32 matching CANVAS_MULTIPLE. Adding app-side fitting would crop TWICE.
The crop literals are in CORE ComfyUI (comfy_extras/nodes_minimax_h3.py), not MpiNodes, and /engine/upgrade wipes it - so a node-side fix was never an option regardless.

The KJNodes triton ImportError on every engine boot is BENIGN and verified so: KJNodes catches it, 242 of its classes register (including ImageResizeKJv2, which H3 depends on), PatchTritonVAE appears in zero shipped workflows, and triton is deliberately excluded from the curated set as engine-owned. Our log relay stamps it [ERROR] though upstream calls it a WARNING - log noise only.
Apps are being renamed FLOWS repo-wide by a parallel agent; docs/playbooks/add-app became add-flow, MpiAppLibrary became MpiFlowLibrary. That agent was told about the block written this session.
constraints: THE OPEN BUG IS A HALF-WIRE, AND SO WAS THE ONE JUST FIXED. Both came from H3 being the first model to break a fleet-wide assumption. Assume there are more: any code that assumes 'multi-stage model => a _stage2 twin file exists' or 'the latent saver is class SaveLatent' is suspect. Sweep, do not spot-fix.

EXISTING COLD PREVIEWS WILL NEVER RECOVER. status:'missing' is written into the item's sidecar by materializePreviewAssets at SAVE time, so previews created before the fix stay COLD no matter what the code does. Delete them before re-testing or you will read a stale failure as a live one.

MpiSaveLatent writes a FIXED filename and OVERWRITES (its own tooltip says so), and routes/projects.js _materializeLatent MOVES the engine's only copy into the project. Not the cause of this session's bug, but a real sharp edge worth remembering.

A WRONG HYPOTHESIS, recorded so it is not re-run: that the fixed filename plus fs.move interacted with ComfyUI's execution cache so only REPEAT previews failed. The user killed it by changing the prompt (different inputs, no cache, still missing) and by a fresh-restart first preview also failing.

NOTHING IS ON R2 AND NOTHING MAY BE. The H3 licence grants rights only outside the EU/UK/USA/South Korea and its trigger covers distribution; publisher URLs are a licence requirement, not an oversight.

ACCEPTANCE RECEIPTS ARE KEYED BY LICENCE ID, NOT MODEL ID. Installing ref2va later shows NO dialog. Deliberate - do not 'fix' it. localStorage key mpi_model_licence_accepted, receipt 'minimax-h3-cla-2026-08-02'.
